title: Mesoscale Neural Operators: Learning Nonlinear Constitutive Laws from Molecular Dynamics for Scalable Fracture Predictions
abstract: arXiv:2611.19658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can capture the nanoscale physics of fracture at the atomistic level, but their computational cost prohibits predictions at the length scales and time scales needed for many applications. Machine learning approaches, on the other hand, have been proposed as heuristic surrogates for material fracture, yet they cannot guarantee the physical consistency of the predicted response. To address this shortcoming, we propose the mesoscale neural operator (MNO): a data-driven nonlocal constitutive model that is learned directly from MD loading and displacement data. After training, it can be used in continuum fracture simulations on much larger domains and grid sizes. The key idea of the MNO is to exploit the built-in characteristic length of a nonlocal model, called the horizon, to travel across scales. translated_title: 介观尺度神经算子：从分子动力学中学习非线性本构定律以实现可扩展的断裂预测
translated_abstract: 分子动力学（MD）模拟能够在原子层面捕获断裂的纳米尺度物理机制，但其计算成本使得在许多应用所需的长度尺度和时间尺度上进行预测变得不可行。另一方面，机器学习方法已被提出作为材料断裂的启发式替代模型，然而它们无法保证预测响应的物理一致性。为解决这一缺陷，我们提出了介观尺度神经算子（MNO）：一种直接从MD加载和位移数据中学习的数据驱动非局部本构模型。经过训练后，它可用于在更大的计算域和网格尺寸上进行连续介质断裂模拟。MNO的关键思想是利用非局部模型中内置的特征长度（称为视界，horizon）来实现跨尺度过渡。通过在MNO中构建两个结构性要素，实现了跨尺度的物理一致性：一个归一化……
tldr: 提出了介观尺度神经算子（MNO），一种直接从分子动力学数据中学习的数据驱动非局部本构模型，利用非局部模型的特征长度（视界）实现跨尺度物理一致性，从而使断裂预测能在更大的计算域和网格上高效进行。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the mesoscale neural operator (MNO), a data-driven nonlocal constitutive model learned directly from molecular dynamics data, which exploits the built-in characteristic length (horizon) of nonlocal models to achieve cross-scale physical consistency and enable scalable continuum fracture predictions on much larger domains.
